notes.title: New Update For Deliverance!
notes.notes:
The patch includes the following:
[list]
	[*]Minor graphical changes and fixes
	[*]The lighting in both the main scene and the black hole scene has been adjusted to make gameplay easier and the environments more realistic
	[*]The opening animation with the players hands has been removed to allow players to start playing immediately
	[*]The black hole scene has been slightly modified for easier playthroughs
	[*]The player's stamina has been modified to be more realistic and to make the gameplay better
	[*]The enemy's sprint speed has been slightly decreased to create balance with the player's stamina
	[*]Sound levels have been adjusted
[/list]
Enjoy! Have fun playing!

notes.title: Deliverance is Out Now!
notes.notes:
Deliverance is officially released on Steam for Windows and Mac.  The game costs $4.99 USD and we cannot wait for you to try it!  We would love to hear your feedback and we hope you enjoy!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/397200
